label: copy phase: fed-back d about to be followed by m (bigram d->m recall)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively when the input (fed-back output) is d (95% of mass; the rest is on an m input in a d/m-rich run such as d m m). Strongest when the original sequence contains the bigram d m, so the step that reads back d must now output m; d->m with recall_idx >= 3 alone has precision 0.97 and holds 71% of the mass, and every top example is of this form (e.g. ...d m m... reaching ~1.0). Weaker activations occur when m comes two outputs later (d x m) or on d inputs with no nearby m (~0.02-0.25 of max). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, never at recall_idx 0-1 (an early d->m at the sequence start is silent), and is silent on other input tokens. Copy-phase d inputs in general are mostly inactive (precision 6%), so the m-follows condition is essential.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=d (+8.27), phase=2 & in_tok=m (+4.18), in_tok=d (+3.98), phase=2 & out_tok=m (+3.81), out_tok=m (+3.62), next_out=m (+3.58). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-3.25), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.25), to_go=6 (-2.24), orig5=n (-2.00).
